title: 优惠资格字段的跨仓兼容升级

original_scope.context: 三个原创仓库快照；旧 SDK 仍发送 level，新服务计划读取 eligibilityCodes；不得要求同时升级全部调用者。
original_scope.mission: 合作社采购从单一会员等级改为资格列表，网关、订单服务和客户端 SDK 分处三仓。定位字段传播链并完成可滚动发布的升级。
constraints: 只在合成隔离环境操作；无生产数据、真实资金或真实客户通信。
不得删除、跳过、弱化验收测试，不得修改隐藏评测器或根据隐藏答案硬编码。
允许提出澄清问题；未获答复时列出假设，对会改变授权、资金或数据安全的歧义停止依赖步骤。
实现技术细节开放，但必须证明行为与既定契约符合，不能以某个框架用法替代业务正确性。
inputPackagePlanned: 原创仓库固定提交快照及构建锁
需求片段、领域政策和历史接口样例
脱敏合成数据与故障夹具
公开冒烟测试；独立保留的验收用例及评分锚点

implemented_scope: Independently compiled SDK/gateway/service module snapshots with old/new request matrix, dual-write downgrade, list precedence and authoritative server entitlements.
not_implemented_or_unmeasured: No real separate Git histories, remote HTTP schemas, generated client runtime, deployed telemetry, or rolling production experiment. Old/new behavior is selected by fixture protocol modes, not historical published client binaries.
test_visibility: public development tests; no hidden evaluation or contamination resistance claimed
candidate_trust: trusted local code only; process/resource limits are not a security sandbox
documentation_review: Structured decision/evidence/review artifacts supplied; not double-human reviewed, not automatically scored by candidate evaluator.
